record_body:
HubSpot feature request (Enterprise prospect) — Route-level A/B testing in Console

Account context
- Prospect is evaluating Redwood Dedicated w/ VPC deployment for regulated workloads (customer service + internal knowledge assistant).
- They have a formal model governance process: every model/config change requires evidence (who changed what, what experiment ran, what the outcome was) and an exportable record for audit.

Key ask: A/B testing feature must meet audit + RBAC + export requirements (not just in-Console charts)

1) Audit logging requirements (must-have)
- Wants a complete lifecycle trail for each experiment:
  - create_experiment, update_experiment (including diff/fields changed), validate, start, stop, rollback, delete/archive
  - traffic_allocation_change events (e.g., 90/10 -> 50/50)
  - guardrail_triggered + auto_rollback_triggered events (if we have automation)
  - permission/role changes related to experiments
- Required audit fields (their words: “We need to reconstruct the story in an audit without screen recordings”):
  - actor identity (user + org), auth method (SSO), source (Console vs API)
  - timestamps in UTC, request id / trace id where applicable
  - experiment_id, project_id, route identifier (API route + project), region scope
  - variant identifiers (model + config hash), allocations, eligibility rules
  - before/after values for updates (or a stable versioned config snapshot id)
- Export/SIEM integration:
  - Prefer streaming to Splunk/QRadar via webhook or “audit log export API”; if not available, at least a periodic export (S3/GCS) in JSON.
  - Asked whether audit events are separate from experiment exposure logs (they want audit events always-on; exposure logs can be sampled).

2) RBAC / permissions model (must-have)
- They need more granularity than current broad Console roles.
- Requested roles (example they gave):
  - Experiment Viewer: can see config + results, cannot change allocations
  - Experiment Operator: can start/stop within pre-approved bounds
  - Experiment Admin: can create/edit/rollback experiments
  - Approver (optional): separation of duties; at minimum, they want an approval workflow or an “approval recorded” field in audit logs
- Scope requirements:
  - Permissions must be scoped by project and route (they want some teams limited to specific endpoints).
  - Needs a “break glass” admin path with additional audit logging.
- Control concerns:
  - They want safeguards against someone routing traffic to an unapproved model variant.

3) Exportable experiment reports (must-have)
- They need a one-click export for a specific experiment and date range:
  - CSV for metrics table + JSON for config snapshot + a human-readable summary (PDF ok, but CSV/JSON is required)
  - Must include: traffic split, exposure counts, p50/p95/p99 latency + TTFT, error/timeout rates, cost attribution summary, and (if attached) eval suite deltas
  - Must include confidence indicators / statistical method used (so reviewers understand significance)
- API access:
  - They asked for an API endpoint to pull the same “report bundle” so they can archive it in their internal governance system.

Additional notes / quotes
- Quote: “We can’t rely on dashboards alone. Our change review board needs an export they can sign off on.”
- Quote: “RBAC is non-negotiable — traffic shifting is a production control, not an analytics feature.”
- They explicitly do NOT want experiment exposure logs to contain PII; aggregated metrics are fine.

Current stage + why it matters
- Stage: Discovery (they’re comparing Redwood vs cloud provider managed endpoints; A/B testing + auditability is a differentiator for them).
- They’re willing to be a beta design partner if:
  - RBAC story is clear (even if initial version is coarse but with roadmap + mitigations)
  - Audit events are defined and export path is not hand-wavy

Internal follow-ups
- Shared internally with: Marissa Cole (PM), Dylan Brooks (Eng lead), Marcus Lin (security consult) for feasibility.
- SE action: confirm what audit event spec will look like and whether we can commit to export format/retention. Clarify separation between audit events vs exposure logs.

Open questions
- Can we support per-route permission scoping in first beta, or do we gate to project-level + audit-only?
- What report export formats are feasible for beta (CSV+JSON) vs GA (PDF bundle)?
- Retention: they asked for 1 year audit retention minimum; exposure logs can be shorter if metrics are retained.

Timeline (recent activities)
- 2026-02-07: inbound via enterprise contact form; requested A/B testing + governance requirements.
- 2026-02-12: SE call w/ platform architect + governance lead (notes attached in internal recap).
- 2026-02-17: joined portion of route A/B testing arch review (Fireflies: ff-2026-02-17-route-ab-testing-arch-review) to hear audit/RBAC approach.
- 2026-02-23: follow-up email: reiterated exportable report requirement; asked for sample audit event payload.
